title: PINR-ESI: Physics-Informed Self-Supervised Implicit Neural Representation Framework for EEG Extended-Source Imaging
abstract: arXiv:2611.06700v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: EEG extended-source imaging aims to localize active cortical regions and characterize their spatial extent, yet supervised inverse networks typically depend on synthetic EEG-source pairs and may be sensitive to synthetic-to-real mismatch. We propose a physics-informed self-supervised implicit neural representation (INR) framework for spatial source reconstruction without paired source labels or simulation-based supervised pretraining. The lead field matrix encodes the source-to-sensor volume-conduction model and constrains the INR through agreement between predicted and measured EEG. Cortical current density is modeled as a continuous coordinate-conditioned field. A classical inverse estimate provides warm initialization and spatial constraints on source activity, while patch-integrated projection maps the field to discrete source coefficients for forward modeling. Simulations with varying noise levels, source counts, and source extents

translated_title: PINR-ESI：面向脑电扩展源成像的物理信息自监督隐式神经表示框架
translated_abstract: 脑电（EEG）扩展源成像旨在定位活跃的皮层区域并刻画其空间范围，然而有监督的逆问题网络通常依赖于合成的脑电-源数据对，且可能对合成数据与真实数据之间的失配较为敏感。我们提出了一种物理信息自监督隐式神经表示（INR）框架，用于空间源重建，无需成对的源标签，也无需基于仿真的有监督预训练。导联场矩阵编码了从源到传感器的容积传导模型，并通过预测脑电与实测脑电之间的一致性来约束隐式神经表示。皮层电流密度被建模为一个连续的、以坐标为条件的场。经典的逆问题估计为源活动提供暖启动初始化和空间约束，同时基于块集成的投影将连续场映射为离散源系数以用于正向建模。在不同噪声水平、源数量和源范围条件下的仿真（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了一种物理信息驱动的自监督隐式神经表示框架PINR-ESI，利用导联场矩阵的物理约束和经典逆估计的暖启动初始化，在无需成对源标签或仿真预训练的情况下实现脑电扩展源成像的空间源重建。
en_tdlr: Proposes PINR-ESI, a physics-informed self-supervised implicit neural representation framework for EEG extended-source imaging, which achieves spatial source reconstruction without paired source labels or simulation-based pretraining by leveraging lead field matrix physical constraints and warm initialization from classical inverse estimates.
